source_row.rationale: Aluminum-containing antacid components tend to cause constipation, while magnesium-containing components tend to cause diarrhea. Many combination antacid products intentionally combine both aluminum and magnesium hydroxide to help balance out and minimize these opposing gastrointestinal side effects.
source_row.source_detail: Balancing Constipation and Diarrhea Effects in Combination Antacids
